The '''76th Assault Regiment''' was a distinguished [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] unit that was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="heroes" /> As an imperial [[assault regiment]], they had around 3,546 members.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
